headline: Profit falls on margin pressure as sales hold flat
summary_short: Albertsons' fiscal Q1 2026 net sales were $24.94 billion, up 0.2% y/y, while net income fell 64.2% y/y to $84.7 million ($0.17 diluted EPS) as gross margin compressed to 26.6% and Adjusted EBITDA fell 8.8% y/y to $1,013.2 million.
summary_long: Net sales rose 0.2% y/y to $24.94 billion as higher fuel sales offset a 0.8% identical-sales decline; digital sales grew 13%. Gross margin fell 50bp to 26.6% on higher delivery costs and fuel costs, partly offset by IRA-driven pharmacy margin gains. SG&A rose to 25.6% of sales on rent, merger-litigation, business-transformation and D&A costs. Net income fell 64.2% y/y to $84.7 million ($0.17 diluted EPS) and Adjusted EBITDA fell 8.8% to $1,013.2 million. Cash rose to $295.0 million from $203.0 million at fiscal year-end. Albertsons announced 'ACI Edge,' consolidating 11 divisions into four regions. The quarterly dividend rose 13% to $0.17/share; $226.5 million was repurchased under a newly expanded $2.0 billion authorization.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by higher fuel sales, which offset a 0.8% decline in identical sales excluding fuel; pharmacy sales grew despite IRA headwinds and digital sales rose 13%.

Gross margin fell to 26.6% from 27.1% on higher digital delivery/handling costs and higher fuel costs, partly offset by IRA-driven pharmacy margin improvement and customer-value-proposition investment.
SG&A rose to 25.6% of sales on higher rent and occupancy costs, merger-related litigation costs, business-transformation costs and depreciation, compounding the gross-margin decline.

Management announced 'ACI Edge,' consolidating 11 divisions into four regions to simplify operations, while raising the dividend 13% and expanding the buyback authorization to $2.0 billion amid a more pressured, value-conscious consumer environment.
